market_summary: Markets are shut today (Tue 24 Nov, Guru Nanak Jayanti) and reopen Wed 25 Nov. On Mon 23 Nov the Nifty fell 1.75% to 25,349.65 and the Sensex 1,484 points (-1.77%) to 82,435.99 after opening higher: metals sank 4.2% (Tata Steel -8.5%, APL Apollo -21.8% on their tubes deal), banks fell over 2%, while IT rose 1.9% (TCS +3.3%) after the Nasdaq's 5% drop on Friday, US-Iran tension and early monthly expiry hit sentiment. Foreign investors still bought ₹5,673 cr (provisional) and domestic funds sold ₹2,760 cr; India VIX was about 18 intraday, up from 17.32. Results season is over; Siemens Energy India reports on 25 Nov. Prices below are from before Monday's fall, so check live quotes.

buy_ideas.name: Apollo Hospitals
buy_ideas.target_source: Macquarie (double upgrade to Outperform from Underperform, target raised from ₹6,230), via INDmoney 20 Nov
buy_ideas.thesis: Q2 FY27 revenue rose 23% to ₹7,615 cr, EBITDA 29% to ₹1,191 cr and profit 32% to ₹630 cr; margin widened to 15.6% from 14.9%. Inpatient volumes +14%, occupancy up to 73%, pharmacy (HealthCo) EBITDA +75%. Stock jumped 5.3% to an all-time high of about ₹9,200 on 20 Nov; Macquarie's ₹10,500 target is about 14% higher, and Motilal had ₹10,400.
buy_ideas.risks: Bought after a 5% one-day jump to a record high, so wait for a dip rather than chasing. Hospital stocks sold off earlier this month on fears of drug-price regulation (Supreme Court query on pharmacy markups); that risk has not gone away. The market fell about 1.8% on 23 Nov; the price shown predates that fall.

buy_ideas.name: Eicher Motors
buy_ideas.thesis: Q2 FY27 revenue rose 20% and profit about 15%. Stock closed ₹8,056 (+4.6%) on 19 Nov as autos rallied 4.4% on cheaper copper and aluminium, which eases the margin worry. Emkay's ₹9,100 target is about 13% above the close.
buy_ideas.risks: EBITDA margin fell 80 bps to 23.7%, and the stock has already jumped in one day; Motilal Oswal is only Neutral at ₹7,420. Metal prices can bounce back. No fresh price found for 20 Nov; ₹8,056 is the 19 Nov close (autos rose about 0.5% on Friday). The market fell about 1.8% on 23 Nov; the price shown predates that fall.

buy_ideas.name: Laurus Labs
buy_ideas.thesis: Q2 FY27 revenue up about 33% to ₹2,206 cr, led by CDMO up about 86%; EBITDA ₹750 cr at a 34% margin (up 962 bps) and profit ₹437 cr. Still the cleanest earnings beat on the list; pharma rose 0.6% on 19 Nov.
buy_ideas.risks: Upside to target only about 9%. CDMO orders are lumpy. No fresh price found; ₹2,338 is the broker's reference price, so check the live quote. The market fell about 1.8% on 23 Nov; the price shown predates that fall.

buy_ideas.name: Hitachi Energy India
buy_ideas.thesis: Q2 FY27 revenue up 64% and profit up 21%; new orders up 86%, taking the order book to ₹33,300 cr. IDBI sees revenue up 57% in FY27 and margins rising to 16.7% by FY28; target about 25% above the reference price.
buy_ideas.risks: Price is implied from the 17 Nov note (no fresh quote found), so check it. Very expensive stock, and profit grew much slower than revenue. The market fell about 1.8% on 23 Nov; the price shown predates that fall.

buy_ideas.name: ABB India
buy_ideas.thesis: September-quarter revenue up 12% and profit up 8%, with a record order book up 36% to about ₹12,900 cr. Two brokers say Buy, targets about 18-20% above the price.
buy_ideas.risks: Margin fell 70 bps and profit growth was modest; valued at about 60 times 2028 earnings. No fresh price found; ₹6,923 is from the earlier broker notes. The market fell about 1.8% on 23 Nov; the price shown predates that fall.

avoid.reason: Fell 21.8% on 23 Nov after agreeing to buy Tata Steel's tubes business and Tata Steel Colors (reports put the deal at ₹16,300-28,000 cr), with Tata Steel taking about 26% and triggering an open offer. Deal news, not earnings; let the price settle.
Fell 8.5% to about ₹163 on 23 Nov on the APL Apollo deal while metals dropped 4.2%. Not an earnings move; wait for clarity on the deal terms.

Management news, not earnings: the bank terminated former MD and CEO Sumant Kathpalia and will reclaim his pay since 2020; the stock bounced about 10% from the day's low on 20 Nov to above ₹1,000. Don't chase a news spike.
USFDA warning letter for its Daman plant, which brings in about 9% of revenue. US approvals from that site can stall; wait for the remediation plan.

Results missed: Q2 EBITDA fell 27% and profit 19% on only 4% revenue growth, and gross margin fell 4.4 points on metal costs. IDBI still says Buy at ₹5,271, but wait for margins to recover.

ICICI Direct says Sell with a ₹490 target (about 10% below ₹544) as margins shrank sharply despite strong revenue.
